tableLines.line: SYSTEM: Neural interface stable. Text overlay enabled.
◈ THE EMBASSY — the table is set, the bundle is served, and the galaxy ate from it. The deed is done — the seat still waits on the deeds.
◈ THE TABLE — between now and the seat, the world holds its breath. The wild can still take your food — but it cannot take your people.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Mateo speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.

Deeper knowledge: Burdock. Uses: starchy root vegetable. Dig first-year plants (no flower stalk). (+5 health when eaten). All uses known: food: first-year roots only — dig deep, peel, cook like carrots; medicine: root tea, traditional blood purifier; fiber: tough stalk fiber for rough cordage.
You caught the lie in his face and watched the whole table react to it before he'd finished the sentence. Face and room, both open books.

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and

◈ THE TABLE — the ring of pale light flickers at the edge of the sky... and does not come. The System does not apologize this time. "WE PRICED THE RUN. THE FIRE BURNED BEFORE THE PELLET, AND WHAT IT BANKED STANDS — BUT THE PELLET HUMS WHERE THE FIRE SHOULD BE, AND NO NEW FEAST CAN CARRY THE SURGE." The ledger still wants: wave-3 monsters faced. The mantle may pass to hungrier hands; the table will
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
👂 Overheard — Maya (to Mateo): "Leo's story has a fresh coat of paint." Maya taps the table. "Scrape it off and you get a trail crew lead. Just don't scrape it in front of them."
